concerns.text: FR-003 and SC-003 require computing synchrony for theta (4–7 Hz) and gamma (30–45 Hz) bands. Task T023 ('Implement frequency band filtering for theta and gamma') is marked incomplete [ ]. Without this task, the core requirement to compute band-specific synchrony metrics is unimplemented.

FR-007 requires a sensitivity analysis with shifted windows [-600, 0] and [-400, 0]. Task T034 ('Implement sensitivity analysis...') is marked incomplete [ ]. This leaves a mandatory spec requirement unaddressed.

FR-005 requires multiple-comparison correction (Bonferroni) for the tested bands. Task T033 ('Implement multiple-comparison correction') is marked incomplete [ ]. The statistical validity requirement is not covered by a task.

SC-001 requires peak RSS ≤ 6.5 GB. Task T018 ('Implement memory monitoring...') is marked incomplete [ ]. While T018b/c handle runtime, the specific memory constraint monitoring task is missing implementation.
FR-003 and US-2 require saving synchrony matrices. Task T025 ('Save synchrony matrices...') is marked incomplete [ ]. The artifact generation for the core metric is not covered.

US-2 and Plan Phase 2 require computation to complete in ≤ 30 minutes per subject. Task T026 ('Ensure computation completes in ≤ 30 minutes...') is marked incomplete [ ]. The performance constraint task is missing.

US-1 requires saving clean epochs. Task T019 ('Save clean epochs to data/processed/') is marked incomplete [ ]. This blocks downstream tasks (T022, T024) and leaves the primary output of US-1 unimplemented.

Task T018b references 'several hours' for timeout violation, but SC-002 and the Plan specify a strict 6-hour limit. The task description should explicitly reference the 6-hour threshold to ensure traceability to the spec.
